name: MECHREVO Linux Control

title.zh: MECHREVO Linux Control · 机械革命本机硬件控制台与蓝牙水冷套件
title.en: MECHREVO Linux Control · Desktop Control Center, BLE Liquid Cooler & EC/Power Suite

techStack: Rust (Tauri 2 / tokio / zbus / native CLI & system helpers)

summary.zh: 面向机械革命耀世系列的 100% 原生 Rust 运行时 Linux 硬件控制中心与系统调校套件：提供 Tauri 2 + React 暗色桌面控制台、零 Python 依赖的 CLI 与 8 个系统助手/守护、外置 LCT22002/LCT21001 蓝牙水冷 Rust 守护、EC 功耗/风扇调校及 NVIDIA 休眠修复。
summary.en: Zero-Python runtime Linux control suite for Mechrevo YAOSHI laptops featuring a Tauri 2 + React dark anodized desktop center, native Rust CLI, full Rust user/root daemon & helper stack, unpaired BLE LCT22002/LCT21001 external water-cooler control, bounded EC/GPU power tuning, and NVIDIA hibernate fixes.

zh: Tauri 2 + React 19 / TypeScript 原生桌面控制台（mechrevo-control-gui）与原生 Rust CLI（iteglow），发行包零 Python 运行时依赖
全栈原生 Rust 后台守护与系统助手（水冷 BLE / 灯光会话 / 狂暴调度 / EC 安全守卫 / Polkit 助手 / 睡眠与 DKMS 钩子），常驻总内存约 6 MB
通过固定 root 助手与受 SHA-256 门禁保护的内核租约模块实现安全性能调校、只读 EC 水冷遥测与 NVIDIA DKMS 休眠修复
en: Native Tauri 2 + React 19 / TypeScript desktop UI (mechrevo-control-gui) and zero-Python Rust CLI (iteglow) with self-contained .deb/.rpm/.AppImage packages
100% native Rust daemon and system-helper runtime stack (BLE water-cooling, lighting/profile session, turbo lease, EC guard, Polkit helper, sleep & DKMS hooks) using ~6 MB resident RAM
Privilege-separated root EC helper, SHA-gated turbo kernel lease module, read-only EC/WMI telemetry bridge, and DKMS NVIDIA hibernate fix
